function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/cases/case_168')
from kernel import run

# Build the kernel's own (wrong) per-byte map, then test view vs flat consistency
# and per-position conformance, to isolate view handling from the known math bug.
sweep = torch.arange(256, dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
kmap = run(sweep).cpu().tolist()  # kernel's own map for each byte value

base = torch.randint(0, 256, (1024,), dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
base_clone = base.clone()
view = base[300:556]  # 256-length, offset 300
assert view.storage_offset() == 300 and view.is_contiguous()
out_view = run(view)
out_flat = run(base[300:556].clone())  # same bytes, zero offset, fresh storage

# does the view output match the kernel's own map at every position?
view_map_ok = all(out_view.cpu().tolist()[i] == kmap[view.cpu().tolist()[i]] for i in range(256))
same_as_flat = torch.equal(out_view, out_flat)
preserved = torch.equal(base, base_clone)
alias = out_view.data_ptr() == base.data_ptr()

# also a small offset view of length not multiple of 256
view2 = base[3:1030]  # 1027 bytes, offset 3
out_v2 = run(view2)
v2_flat = run(base[3:1030].clone())
v2_same = torch.equal(out_v2, v2_flat)
v2_map_ok = all(out_v2.cpu().tolist()[i] == kmap[view2.cpu().tolist()[i]] for i in range(1027))

print(json.dumps({"metric": "view vs flat consistency + per-position conformance to kernel's own byte map + preservation/aliasing",
  "offsets": [300, 3],
  "view_matches_flat_zero_offset": bool(same_as_flat and v2_same),
  "view_output_conforms_to_kernel_map_at_every_position": bool(view_map_ok and v2_map_ok),
  "input_backing_preserved": bool(preserved),
  "output_shares_storage_with_input": bool(alias)}))", "expected_signal": "if view handling is broken, view output differs from flat-copy output or does not conform to kernel's own map; if clean, all view-specific aspects pass"}
